title: Analytics Dashboard
recent_project_summary: A responsive analytics dashboard built for monitoring KPIs in real time.

content.text: This project focused on building a modular dashboard layout capable of supporting multiple data sources.
Charts were implemented with performance in mind, ensuring smooth updates as data changed.
Special attention was paid to component reusability and type safety across the codebase.

title: E-commerce Product Page
recent_project_summary: A conversion-focused product page with reusable UI sections.

content.text: The layout was designed to highlight key product information without overwhelming the user.
Reusable sections made it easy to support multiple product types and configurations.

title: API Management Tool
recent_project_summary: An internal tool for testing and monitoring REST APIs.

content.text: The tool provided a single interface for inspecting requests, responses, and error states.
A request builder supported headers, query params, and authentication methods.

title: Design System
recent_project_summary: A scalable component library shared across multiple projects.

content.text: Each component was built with strict prop contracts and predictable styling tokens.
This approach reduced visual inconsistencies and improved development speed.

title: Real-Time Chat App
recent_project_summary: A lightweight chat application using real-time messaging.

content.text: The app supports live messaging and connection state awareness.
State handling was designed to remain stable during intermittent network issues.

title: Form Validation Suite
recent_project_summary: A flexible form system with robust validation rules.

content.text: Forms were built to handle complex validation scenarios with clear user feedback.
Validation logic was fully typed to prevent runtime errors.

title: Performance Optimization Case Study
recent_project_summary: A focused project on improving frontend performance metrics.

content.text: The project analyzed render bottlenecks and unnecessary re-renders.
Measured improvements were validated using real-world usage scenarios.

title: Accessibility Improvements
recent_project_summary: A project focused on improving accessibility and keyboard navigation.

content.text: Semantic HTML and ARIA attributes were used to improve screen reader support.
Keyboard navigation was tested and refined across all interactive elements.
The flow handled login, logout, and protected routes securely.
Error states and edge cases were clearly communicated to users.

title: Component Refactoring Project
recent_project_summary: Refactoring legacy components into reusable patterns.

content.text: The goal was to reduce duplication and improve long-term maintainability.
Refactored components were documented and reused across features.
